args: Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; function Get-EnvMap([string]$Path){$map=@{};$lines=Get-Content -Path $Path -Raw -Encoding UTF8;foreach($rawLine in ($lines -split "`r?`n")){ $line=$rawLine.Trim(); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line) -or $line.StartsWith('#')){continue}; $idx=$line.IndexOf('='); if($idx -lt 1){continue}; $key=$line.Substring(0,$idx).Trim(); $val=$line.Substring($idx+1).Trim(); if((($val.StartsWith('"') -and $val.EndsWith('"')) -or ($val.StartsWith("'") -and $val.EndsWith("'"))) -and $val.Length -ge 2){$val=$val.Substring(1,$val.Length-2)}; $map[$key]=$val}; $map }; $envMap=Get-EnvMap '.env'; $ftpHost=[string]$envMap['FTP_HOST_LIVE']; if(-not $ftpHost.StartsWith('ftp://') -and -not $ftpHost.StartsWith('ftps://')){$ftpHost='ftp://'+$ftpHost}; $auth=([string]$envMap['FTP_USER_LIVE'])+':' +([string]$envMap['FTP_PASS_LIVE']); $remoteBase=([string]$envMap['FTP_REMOTE_PATH_LIVE']).Trim('/','\\'); foreach($rel in @('public/tmp_run_migration_031.php','public/tmp_run_migration_032.php')){ Write-Host "Uploading $rel"; & curl.exe --silent --show-error --fail --ftp-create-dirs -u $auth -T (Join-Path (Get-Location) $rel) "$ftpHost/$remoteBase/$rel" | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "Upload failed: $rel" } }; Write-Host 'Public migration wrappers uploaded.'
